items.quote: He knows how to keep raw emotions the way I do love. Through many events I have given special love to NUC — I can feel the pure love, emotion, and passion here. I know he will deliver exactly the emotion through the way he puts it in every frame. He always stuns me!
items.author: Nguyen Tuan Anh

items.quote: Even when you're quietly building something behind the scenes, I'm already waiting for it to blow up. AnDo has a rare instinct for sport — whatever he's cooking, I know it's going to be something special.
items.author: Ngo Quang Duong
